title: 第六十九章 来自轮回乐园的关心第六十八章 抵达古龙大陆
content_zh:
“前段时间，有虚空生物屠杀了北岸边境的金鳞龙部族，横穿北风苔原后，试图从龙血石林进入龙骨滩，被值守的金属岩龙和精灵龙，当场击杀。”
当振翅领航在前的亚戈，那平铺直叙的声音顺着风雪，传入王长乐耳中时，他瞬间就感知到了，从三头冰霜巨龙体内散发的各种情绪。
愤怒、杀戮、愤恨，以及极致压抑
对此心中已有所猜测的王长乐，并未多言，只是静静望着下方被冰晶雾风覆盖的山林，所呈现雾凇奇景。
他很清楚灰绅士既然选择做了，可能会失手，但绝不可能没有后手。
“事后，在枯骨礁石附近，发现了金属岩龙和冰霜巨龙的尸体，精灵龙部落指认是冰霜巨龙，发起的此次侵入，我们可是戈蒙先祖的后裔，怎么会…”
“所以，你们才准备封锁龙骨滩周边区域，想要自证清白？”
“昂～巨龙的荣耀不需要证明。”
“古龙冕下，封锁龙骨滩是因为在换防期间，铁翼?戈蒙先祖的龙核被偷了，这对于我们冰霜巨龙而言，属于不可饶恕的屈辱。”
“你们确定……人还在龙骨滩？”
王长乐望着远处被超大范围冰晶薄雾，所笼罩的脊椎岭，眼前瞬时一亮，世界简介中的内容，他记得很清楚。
当年，正是有了铁翼?戈蒙不计代价的自爆，才有了这龙骨滩的原型。
之所以会有如今的规模，主要是因这成为龙族幼崽获取‘龙威’的试炼点，有不少部族会将战死龙族骸骨，葬在这
铁翼?戈蒙当时的死亡过于壮烈，别说是龙核了，就连龙骨都是残缺，如今所谓的龙核，大概率就是世界之核。
当以冰晶薄雾构建帷幕，在戈蒙爪下被划出条缝时，他的声音再次响起。
“在『龙骨祭坛』警示的第一时间，就以这冰晶雾界封死了所有区域，非冰霜巨龙无法进出，但保龙魂意志不受侵扰，这里禁止任何形式的破坏。”
“所以只要抓到了人，你们就能解除全面封锁，开启龙魂试炼？”
“对，不过您可能要等上一段时间了，现在的搜索范围还太……”
“如果不介意的话，给我点时间，让我来帮你们把人揪出来，如何？”
王长乐这边话音刚落，冰霜巨龙们瞬间悬停在空中，下方除了茫茫无际的冰川，就什么都看不到了。

三双龙目几乎在瞬间，齐刷刷地落到了王长乐身上，直到这种沉默过了数秒，那为首的亚戈，才开了口。
“如果古龙冕下，能帮忙寻回先祖遗核，等到龙魂试炼开启，我霜翼?戈蒙可以亲自为您引路。”
“好，那我们就这么说定了。”
王长乐只是眸光微动，身体于虚实转化间，就悬停在了脊椎岭的高空。
如此一幕，瞬时就引来了山林附近区域，十数头冰霜巨龙的关注。
不过，在亚戈的古龙语的安抚下，这种意外的躁动，很快就得到了平息。
“嗡”
也就在这一刻，低头的王长乐，很快就在众目睽睽下，陷入了沉睡。
下一秒，那独属于梦境的褐色雾霭，顿时自高空沉降、垂落、蔓延。
在王长乐的操控下，那极速扩散的褐色雾霭中，很快就覆盖了大半山头，以雪崩的姿态，向着远处猛冲。
“呼”
沿途所过之处，冰霜巨龙尽数避让
将一切尽收眼底的亚戈，瞳孔瞬间收缩，这倒并非是他在那轻薄的雾影中，看到了百米级的中世纪巨轮。
关键在于，那艘中世纪巨轮甲板上，挤满了太阳神教神职者的身影。
心生疑惑的他，刚想要看得再清楚点，就见船舷某道人影，陡然将抬头，将目光投了过来。
“呋”
亚戈只觉眼前一花，视线再恢复时，人就已然出现在了一处船舱内部。
窗外视角是向下，极速俯冲的雾风
这船舱内部不到百来平，可坐在长脚凳上的亚戈，不仅没有半点逼仄的感觉，甚至都没有任何的失重感。
下一秒，王长乐举着红酒的身影，就凭空出现在了，亚戈的正对面。

“古神冕下，这里……”
“这里是我的梦境世界，你可以叫我源初，把你的意识扯进来，很抱歉，但如果可以的话，不要窥视我。”
“！”
亚戈刚想开口，四方场景又骤然变得扭曲模糊，当他的视线再次恢复时，只见那茫茫雾霭，已覆盖了大半山头。
content_en:
"Some time ago, a void creature massacred the Golden Scale Dragon tribe on the border of the north coast. After crossing the Borean Tundra, it tried to enter the Dragon Bone Beach from the Dragon Blood Stone Forest. It was killed on the spot by the metal rock dragon and elf dragon on duty."
When Yago, who was flying ahead, flapped his wings and his plain voice followed the wind and snow, and reached Wang Changle's ears, he instantly sensed the various emotions emanating from the three-headed frost dragon.
Anger, killing, resentment, and extreme depression
Wang Changle, who had already made a guess about this, did not say much, but quietly looked at the mountain forest below covered by ice crystal fog and wind, showing the wonderful scene of rime.
He knew very well that since Gray Gentleman had chosen to do it, he might fail, but he would never be without a backup plan.
"Afterwards, the bodies of the Metal Rock Dragon and the Frost Dragon were found near the Bone Reef. The Elf Dragon Tribe identified it as the Frost Dragon and initiated this invasion. We are the descendants of the Gomon ancestors. How could we..."
"So, you are planning to seal off the area around Dragon Bone Beach and want to prove your innocence?"
"Ang~ The dragon's glory does not need proof."
"Under the Ancient Dragon Crown, the reason for sealing off the Dragon Bone Beach is because during the defense change, the dragon core of Iron Wing Gomon's ancestor was stolen. This is an unforgivable humiliation for our frost dragons."
"Are you sure... people are still at Dragon Bone Beach?"
Wang Changle looked at the Spinal Ridge in the distance, shrouded in a large-scale ice crystal mist, and his eyes suddenly lit up. He remembered the contents of the world introduction very clearly.
Back then, it was because of Tieyi Gomon's self-destruction regardless of the cost that the prototype of Dragon Bone Beach was created.
The main reason why it has its current scale is that it has become a trial point for dragon cubs to obtain the ‘Dragon Power’. Many tribes will bury the skeletons of dragons killed in battle here.
Iron Wing Gomen's death at that time was too heroic. Not to mention the dragon core, even the keel bones were incomplete. Nowadays, the so-called dragon core is most likely the core of the world.
When the veil made of ice crystal mist was sliced ​​open under Gormon's claws, his voice sounded again.
"At the first warning of the 'Dragon Bone Altar', all areas were sealed with this ice crystal fog boundary. Non-frost dragons cannot enter or exit, but the will of the dragon soul is not disturbed. Any form of destruction is prohibited here."
"So as long as you catch someone, you can lift the total blockade and start the Dragon Soul Trial?"
"Yes, but you may have to wait for a while. The current search scope is too..."
"If you don't mind, how about giving me some time and letting me help you find the person?"
As soon as Wang Changle finished speaking, the frost dragons instantly hovered in the air, and nothing could be seen below except the boundless glaciers.
Three pairs of dragon eyes fell on Wang Changle almost instantly. It was not until several seconds of silence passed that the leader, Ya Ge, spoke.
"If the Ancient Dragon Crown can help you find the ancestral core, when the Dragon Soul Trial begins, I, Frostwing Gemeng, can personally guide you."
"Okay, then we've settled on that."
Wang Changle just moved his eyes slightly, and his body was hovering high in the sky above the spine ridge while the body was changing between reality and reality.
Such a scene immediately attracted the attention of dozens of frost dragons in the area near the mountain forest.
However, under the comfort of Yago's ancient dragon language, this unexpected restlessness was quickly calmed down.
"Buzz"
At this moment, Wang Changle, who bowed his head, quickly fell into a deep sleep in full view of everyone.
The next second, the brown mist that belonged exclusively to dreams suddenly settled, fell, and spread from high in the sky.
Under Wang Changle's control, the rapidly spreading brown mist soon covered most of the mountain, rushing toward the distance like an avalanche.
"Hoo"
Wherever they pass along the way, the frost dragons avoid them all.
Yago, who had seen everything in sight, shrank his pupils instantly. This was not because he saw the 100-meter-level medieval tower in the thin mist.Giant wheel.
The key is that the deck of that medieval giant ship was crowded with priests of the Sun Cult.
He was confused and just wanted to see more clearly when he saw a figure on the side of the ship suddenly raised his head and cast his gaze over.
"Fu"
Yago felt his eyes blurred, and when his sight returned again, the person had already appeared inside a cabin.
The perspective outside the window is downward, the foggy wind swooping down at a very fast speed
The interior of the cabin is less than a hundred square meters, but Yago, sitting on the long stool, not only does not feel cramped at all, but does not even feel weightless.
The next second, Wang Changle's figure holding red wine appeared out of thin air, directly opposite Ya Ge.
"Under the ancient god's crown, here..."
"This is my dream world. You can call me Yuanchu and drag your consciousness into it. I'm sorry, but if you can, don't peek at me."
"!"
Just as Yago was about to speak, the scene in all directions suddenly became distorted and blurred. When his vision returned again, he saw that the vast mist had covered most of the mountain.
